title: Rigidity of Nilpotent Lie Foliations: Cohomological Obstructions and Classification
summary: In this article, we develop a systematic cohomological framework for the study of the rigidity of nilpotent Lie foliations with respect to solvable deformations. We introduce the deformation complex associated to a pair of Lie algebras $(\mathfrak{g}, \mathfrak{h})$ and show that the main obstruction to deforming a nilpotent Lie foliation into a non-nilpotent solvable foliation lies in the cohomology group $H^2(\mathfrak{g},\mathfrak{g}/[\mathfrak{g},\mathfrak{g}])$.
